scope: Every named writer field is enumerated; wildcard rules cover all other own keys. Read with REPORT.md for phase/error/presence rules. No materiality claim.

wire.spread: All input own enumerable string/symbol keys copied only after validation; existing key positions survive overrides; nonenumerable keys are not spread.

otherSources.name: text(row.name ?? row.jjjc,160) || code
otherSources.source: text(row.source,120) || unavailable; usable row requires nonempty source
otherSources.kind: canonical kind then est_kind alias then v1 intraday default; unusable becomes unavailable
otherSources.status: normalized usable ok or unusable unavailable
otherSources.base_nav_date: own canonical else canonicalKind ? null : nav_date ?? gzrq; unusable output null
otherSources.source_time: own source_time else estimate_time ?? est_time ?? gxrq; usable checks clock/precision; unusable output null
otherSources.value_date: own value_date else official canonical nav_date else source-date; unusable output null
otherSources.nav_date: official targetDate else baseDate; not blindly nullified for unusable
otherSources.est_kind: initial official/qdii/holdings/intraday kind alias, even if transport becomes unavailable
otherSources.report_date: own report_date else model_report_date, alias conflict check, safe text10 or null

publicPresentation.earlyIdentity: String(row?.code || row?.bzdm || empty); invalid regex returns null before wire call
publicPresentation.spread: Spread wire output before these own overlays. Real second-validation ROW_INVALID rescue substitutes a smaller wire shape; it does not spread the old input.

sources.code: first public identity read, not later wire/spread code
sources.name: safeText(wire.name || code,160)
sources.nav_date: wire.base_nav_date || empty; official public row therefore uses base, unlike wire nav_date
sources.source_time_precision: minute if sourceTime has HH:MM, else date; replaces v2 datetime literal
sources.est_realtime: row.est_realtime exactly true and wire.kind intraday and source_status in fresh/ok/success/realtime
sources.diagnostics: if original row.diagnostics truthy object, enumerable spread clone; otherwise empty object

publicPresentation.safeRescue: Only genuine same-public-class WorkerContractError code WORKER_ROW_INVALID inside wire try; name/status getters in rescue and presentation after try can still throw. Other errors propagate.
publicPresentation.lateStatusMutation: Only normalized.status === ok with unavailable source_quote becomes error; fill message only if empty. Unavailable versus safe-rescue error remains distinct.

sources.fundCode: firstText(options.fundCode,row.fundCode,row.code,row.bzdm); row.fundCode passthrough can cause resource identity rejection
sources.fundName: firstText(options.fundName,row.fundName,row.name,row.jjjc,fundCode); envelope output empty becomes own undefined
sources.assetKind: options.assetKind || classifyAssetKind(fundName,market); createEnvelope enum fallback unknown
sources.valueKind: kind/est_kind plus est_model/est_holdings_model flags via kindFromRow; generic legacy fallback intraday
sources.value: first OWN value_nav/est_nav/value, nullable positive; unavailable status forces null
sources.changePct: official first OWN value_change/est_change/changePct; other first OWN estimate_change/value_change/est_change/changePct; unavailable forces null
sources.baseNav: first OWN base_nav/baseNav/last_nav nullable positive; unavailable forces null
sources.baseNavDate: first OWN base_nav_date/baseNavDate/nav_date normalized date; explicit null prevents alias rescue
sources.targetDate: first OWN value_date/targetDate/target_nav_date; only absent field uses source-day for nonmodel; model absent stays unbound
sources.sourceId: canonical firstText(row.source,row.sourceId,kind default); cache output becomes local-cache
sources.sourceTier: cache if exact row.sourceTier cache; else model for model kinds; fallback/official secondary; else registry primary default
sources.originalSource: original-source canonicalization; cache preserves original source; unknown becomes null
sources.cacheState: fresh/stale/expired plus metadata/provenance/clock checks; noncache output null
sources.cachedAt: nonnegative safe integer or null, even noncache own output
sources.expiresAt: nonnegative safe integer or null, with cache monotonic checks
sources.fetchedAt: firstText(row.fetched_at,row.fetchedAt,options.fetchedAt); valid ISO normalized; invalid/missing live falls back now, cached falls back null
sources.officialNavDate: firstText(row.officialNavDate,official value_date,official est_time,row.nav_date) || null; date normalized
sources.status: freshness plus Quote enum/value/future-date/model-period/cache checks; not wire status
sources.ageMs: observed timestamp age max0, null if missing or excessive future skew
sources.coverage: row.coverage ?? model_coverage ?? est_coverage ?? est_model_weight then nullable range0..100
sources.confidence: row.confidence ?? est_confidence; low/medium/high or numeric normalization; nullable
sources.modelVersion: row.model_version ?? estimate_model_version ?? est_model_version, text or null
sources.reasonCodes: bounded whitelist-normalized worker reasons/status/fallback plus freshness/period/cache reasons; unique frozen max20

quote.assetKindCorrection: Current identity() does not read row.assetKind: only options.assetKind or classifyAssetKind. Do not invent row.assetKind influence in this HTTP path.
quote.immutability: Quote and reasonCodes frozen; unknown input keys are not copied into Quote.

resource.lastField: source_quote appended after all selected own ROW_FIELDS
resource.presence: Own property only; never synthesize absent ROW_FIELDS. Undefined own may exist before JSON and is dropped by JSON later; null is retained. Select can copy a nonenumerable allowed own input field into an enumerable output field.
resource.generalScalarRule: For every selected field: null/undefined accepted; booleans and numbers accepted unless a field-specific earlier check rejects; other values require safeString max300. Every nonfinite number converts to null. Not a universal per-field strict string schema.
resource.agreementRule: Null/undefined/NaN placeholders accepted; present nonnull numeric aliases must be number, finite or NaN, and finite difference <=1e-7. No coercing strings. Infinity rejected in agreement aliases, even though generic nonfinite metadata is converted to null.
specificRules: row.source canonical equals Quote.sourceId when nonnull
kind/est_kind map exactly to Quote kind when nonnull
strict Object.keys row/Quote allowlists; own symbols/nonenumerable extras are not part of this Object.keys test
resource.payloadPresence: Common/estimates allowed order, own only. Default acquisition creates codes/rows/source; output order becomes source,codes,rows. Must preserve optional own payload metadata, request order and partial nonempty row order.

appProjection.identity: Either nonnull quote or source_quote with fundCode !== row.code invalidates whole cached financial row, not just one candidate.
appProjection.holdingAuthority: Current repository shares ??0 and cost ??null; never cached holding amounts; reproject at repository reconciliation and render-time.
appProjection.sourceQuoteVsSelected: Keep original immutable primary source_quote separate from selected quote and latest_nav_move.

secondaryEvidence.dualFlagCollision: Both model flags may remain true after sequential installations; later overseas writes shared est_nav/change/time/note. Preserve effective legacy candidate inputs/order unless separately changed.

aggregate.rowWildcard: All other own enumerable string fields remain in Object.entries order then normal JSON.stringify semantics. Symbols are dropped by Object.entries; undefined/functions omitted and nonfinite numbers become null at JSON boundary.
aggregate.editTopUnknown: Preserved by {...previous,data,holdingsHash}; preserves old top acquisition clocks/source/resources and their original key positions.
aggregate.refreshClockRule: Only a valid fresh staged nav/holdings/estimates entry with genuine newer acquisition advances aggregate fetchedAt/expiresAt/source; time only if old own time existed. Market/meta-only acquisition never advances fund clocks.
aggregate.editClockRule: Holding edits/external repository installation only reproject amounts/hash; no resource/acquisition renewal. Empty active portfolio may remove cache under existing App policy.
aggregate.legacyRead: Quote-present/source_quote-present/raw-legacy paths remain accepted as before; cache hydration performs no persistence write.

wildcards.wireAndPublic: Every input own enumerable string/symbol not overwritten is retained shallowly, including unknown nested object references; known Quote readers may consume such fields before resource prune. No early generic allowlist.
wildcards.resource: Non-whitelisted fields are discarded on acquisition; strict persisted validation rejects unknown enumerable string keys. Symbols/nonenumerable keys follow actual own/Object.keys rules, not a broader invented reject.
wildcards.aggregateRow: Preserve unknown own enumerable string entries except three blacklist keys, but apply trusted derived overrides in old order; bad identity discards whole prior row before unknown preservation.
wildcards.publicAPIs: Original source/public outputs remain compatible and copied to site; they need not all remain in the default bundle. Public arbitrary-object getter/symbol/error semantics are not replaced by a private JSON-only assumption.
